title: Selling tapes in my cousin, Peter Paul M’Swiney’s.
html_source: For a time Oliver St. John Gogarty’s father worked in Clery & Co. (formerly M'Swiney & Co.), drapers, silk mercers, hosiers, glovers, haberdashers, jewelers, boot and shoe makers, tailors, woolen drapers, and general warehousers, 21-27 Sackville (now O'Connell) Street. Peter Paul M'Swiney, cousin of Joyce’s grandmother’s, was a successful merchant-politician and lord mayor of Dublin in 1864 and 1875
